# managed-by: personal-multi-harness-workstation-configuration; source: global/allow-list.conf; release: <RELEASE>; commit: <COMMIT>; do not edit, re-run the installer
# The workstation allow list, narrow tier (ADR-0031). A forbidden rule (the deny floor) beats an allow
# rule whatever file holds it (measured, codex execpolicy check). Test runners have no rule here:
# they run inside the workspace-write sandbox of the "workstation" profile without one.
prefix_rule(pattern=["git", "status"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["git", "rev-parse"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["git", "describe"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["git", "worktree", "list"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["gh", "issue", "view"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["gh", "issue", "list"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["gh", "pr", "view"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["gh", "pr", "list"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["gh", "pr", "diff"], decision="allow")
prefix_rule(pattern=["gh", "pr", "checks"], decision="allow")

# managed-by: personal-multi-harness-workstation-configuration; source: global/allow-list.conf; release: <RELEASE>; commit: <COMMIT>; do not edit, re-run the installer
# The workstation permission profile, narrow tier (ADR-0031). Use it with: codex --profile workstation
approval_policy = "on-request"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"

{
  "name": "workstation",
  "description": "managed-by: personal-multi-harness-workstation-configuration; source: global/allow-list.conf; release: <RELEASE>; commit: <COMMIT>; do not edit, re-run the installer",
  "tools": [
    "*"
  ],
  "allowedTools": [
    "fs_read"
  ],
  "toolsSettings": {
    "execute_bash": {
      "allowedCommands": [
        "^git status( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^git rev-parse( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^git describe( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^git worktree list( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^gh issue view( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^gh issue list( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^gh pr view( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^gh pr list( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^gh pr diff( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$",
        "^gh pr checks( [^;&|<>$`(){}\\n\\r]*)?$"
      ],
      "autoAllowReadonly": false
    }
  },
  "permissions": {
    "rules": [
      {
        "capability": "shell",
        "match": [
          "git status *",
          "git status",
          "git rev-parse *",
          "git rev-parse",
          "git describe *",
          "git describe",
          "git worktree list *",
          "git worktree list",
          "gh issue view *",
          "gh issue view",
          "gh issue list *",
          "gh issue list",
          "gh pr view *",
          "gh pr view",
          "gh pr list *",
          "gh pr list",
          "gh pr diff *",
          "gh pr diff",
          "gh pr checks *",
          "gh pr checks"
        ],
        "exclude": [
          "*;*",
          "*&*",
          "*|*",
          "*<*",
          "*>*",
          "*$*",
          "*`*",
          "*(*",
          "*)*",
          "*{*",
          "*}*",
          "*\n*",
          "*\r*"
        ],
        "effect": "allow"
      },
      {
        "capability": "fs_read",
        "effect": "allow"
      }
    ]
  }
}
